summary: This Form 8-K is a routine Item 8.01 disclosure by Energy 11, L.P., a Delaware LP. It reports scheduled monthly cash distributions for 2026 ($0.12 per unit for August and September) plus a special distribution of $0.12 per unit intended to reduce accumulated unpaid distributions. Total October distributions approximate $4.6 million. There are no M&A or special-situation events; the filing solely covers ordinary quarterly cash distributions to existing unitholders. No premium, stake, or structural changes are involved, and the registrant acts as the payer/issuer. The 7% annualized accumulated-distribution feature is a standard LP payout schedule, not a capital return special situation.
